description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling and analyzing distributed training trace data, specifically focusing on collective and point-to-point operations within the PyTorch distributed flight recorder component. It includes functions to match events, verify data consistency, format trace entries, and identify coalesced groups in the trace logs.

methods.name: str format_frame(frame: dict[str, str])
methods.description: Formats a single stack frame dictionary into a human-readable string.

methods.name: str format_frames(frames: list[dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Formats a list of stack frame dictionaries into a human-readable string, joining multiple frames.

methods.name: MatchInfo match_one_event( event_a: dict[Any, Any], event_b: dict[Any, Any], memberships: dict[str, set[Any]], pg_name: str, )
methods.description: Matches two events (represented as dictionaries) to determine their correspondence and match status.

methods.name: bool match_coalesced_groups( all_rank_events: dict[Any, Any], group_size: int, groups: dict[str, Group], memberships: dict[str, set[Any]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], )
methods.description: Verifies if a set of coalesced collective events across multiple ranks form a valid group based on matching rules.

methods.name: bool match_coalesced_groups_with_non_p2p( all_rank_events: dict[Any, Any], pg_info: tuple[str, str], memberships: dict[str, set[Any]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], mismatch: dict[str, int], dumps_ranks: set[int], version: str, collectives: list[Collective], match_record: MatchStateRecord, )
methods.description: Verifies non-P2P coalesced groupings, including handling of non-coalesced events and matching across ranks.

methods.name: tuple[bool,int,int] check_size_alltoall(alltoall_cases: list[dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Checks whether the input and output sizes for alltoall operations match, and sums the total elements.

methods.name: None check_current_entry_match( all_entries: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], pg_info: tuple[str, str], current_entry: dict[str, Any], _memberships: dict[str, set[Any]], mismatch: dict[str, int], match_record: MatchStateRecord, )
methods.description: Checks if the current event entry matches other expected events based on record ID and process group.

methods.name: None error_analysis( all_entries: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]], match_record: MatchStateRecord, dumps_ranks: set[int], first_rank: int, current_entry: dict[str, Any], mismatch: dict[str, int], version: tuple[int, int], pg_name: str, )
methods.description: Performs error analysis on collective entries, detecting issues like missing ranks, size mismatches, or errors in the trace.

methods.name: list[tuple[int,dict[str,Any]]] find_coalesced_group( pg_name: str, entries: list[dict[str, Any]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], rank: int, )
methods.description: Identifies a group of entries forming a coalesced collective operation sharing the same sequence ID.

methods.name: list[tuple[int,dict[str,Any]]] find_coalesced_group_with_non_p2p( pg_name: str, entries: list[dict[str, Any]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], rank: int, )
methods.description: Identifies a group of entries forming a non-P2P coalesced collective sharing the same sequence ID.

methods.name: None just_print_entries( all_entries: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]], _groups: dict[str, Group], _memberships: dict[str, set[Any]], _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], args: argparse.Namespace, stack_id_trace_map: dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Prints trace entries in a tabulated format, optionally including stack traces.

methods.name: None check_no_missing_dump_files( entries: dict[int, Any], memberships: list[Membership] )
methods.description: Verifies that dump files for all ranks are present.

methods.name: None check_version(version_by_ranks: dict[str, str], version: str)
methods.description: Checks if all ranks have the same version of the trace data.

methods.name: tuple[int,int] get_version_detail(version: str)
methods.description: Parses a version string into major and minor version numbers.

methods.name: tuple[dict[int,list[dict[str,Any]]],dict[str,int]] add_stack_id_in_entries( entries: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]], )
methods.description: Assigns stack IDs to trace entries based on their stack frames for easier grouping.

methods.name: dict[int,list[dict[str,Any]]] align_trace_from_beginning( entries: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]], )
methods.description: Aligns trace entries across ranks by filtering out entries before the common starting point.

methods.name: None visualize_ops( match: bool, _pg_guids: dict[tuple[str, int], str], )
